text.title: PR Mentoring Session Protocol Decision Tree

decision-tree.root-question: Is there an open PR authored by the junior with at least one review comment from the senior on a specific diff line?

branch.conclusion: Skip: without a PR and a line-level comment there is nothing to mentor on. Wait for the next PR or run an ordinary review.

branch.question: Is there exactly one learning goal for this session, phrased as an observable code behaviour?

branch.conclusion: Pick one goal in observable terms before commenting further; park the others for later sessions.

branch.question: Can the observed gap be pointed at a specific diff line or comment URL, describing what the code did versus what it should do?

branch.conclusion: Rewrite the gap as a code behaviour with a line anchor; a trait description is rejected.

branch.question: Does a prior session record exist for this junior with a named follow-up action?

branch.conclusion: Link the prior record, set `prior_action_status`, and if this is the third `not-demonstrated` in a row change the intervention and escalate in `decision`.
Run the full session: labelled comments with counts, junior restates and writes the fix, deferred findings parked, follow-up named as a next PR, record shared with the junior.

example.p: PR #412 by `swe:bohdan`, senior comment on `migrations/0042.py#L18` (non-idempotent `ALTER`). Goal: "writes migrations safe to re-run". Prior record exists, follow-up PR #398 showed the same gap → `prior_action_status: not-demonstrated` (second time) → conclusion r-progression-linked-to-prior-session; decision names a 30-minute pairing exercise before PR #420.
